notes: You can now sell feed by the kilo out of an open bag. Put a price per kilo on the product, open a bag, then type the kilos — whole or half.
Quantities can be changed on the order itself now, beside the total, instead of only on the product.
The app counts how many bags are open, next to how many are still sealed. What is left inside an open bag is still not counted — that is on the sack, not the app.
Opening a bag now asks first and shows what the count will become, instead of doing it on one click with nothing to undo it.
Finishing an open bag is on the same menu, so the count means bags that are open rather than bags ever opened.
What you type on the delivery screen is kept if you leave the screen and come back.
